The Commander, 4 Brigade Nigerian Army, Brigadier General Ahmed Balogun, has decorated 52 soldiers with their new ranks following their successful promotion in the Nigerian Army’s 2026 Promotion Exercise. The decoration ceremony, held on November 24, 2026, at the Tiger 4 Mess Extension, Headquarters 4 Brigade, Benin City, Edo State, recognised the soldiers’ dedication, commitment and contributions to the Nigerian Army. According to a statement issued on Wednesday by the Assistant Director, Army Public Relations, 4 Brigade, Captain Kennedy Anyanwu, Balogun congratulated the beneficiaries and charged them to remain focused, diligent and loyal to constituted superior authorities. The Brigade Commander reminded the soldiers that promotion came with increased responsibilities and higher expectations, urging them to justify the confidence reposed in them. “Your promotion comes with increased responsibilities and higher expectations. You must therefore remain focused, diligent and loyal to constituted superior authorities,” Balogun charged. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. The commander also encouraged them to take advantage of available military courses and training opportunities to improve their professional competence. He further advised the soldiers to embrace continuous personal development through the study of relevant books and professional materials, particularly in regimentation and man management. According to him, such knowledge would enhance their effectiveness both in the field and within their respective units. PHOTOS: Army commander decorates promoted soldiers in Abuja Four Edo security operatives arrested for aiding cultists Edo consumer committee rejects NAFDAC warning over product enforcement Balogun described their promotion as recognition of their hard work, dedication and exemplary service to the Nigerian Army and the country. He also emphasised the importance of discipline, integrity, loyalty, mutual respect and continuous self-development as essential qualities of effective soldiers. The commander expressed appreciation to the Chief of Army Staff, Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu, for approving the promotions and reaffirmed 4 Brigade’s commitment to supporting the attainment of the COAS Command Philosophy. In her remarks on behalf of the newly promoted soldiers, Master Warrant Officer Alice Yakubu expressed gratitude to the Nigerian Army leadership for finding them worthy of promotion. “We sincerely appreciate the leadership of the Nigerian Army for the confidence reposed in us. We assure you that we will justify this trust through renewed commitment to discipline, professionalism and effective service,” Yakubu said. She pledged that the beneficiaries would continue to contribute to the growth and operational effectiveness of 4 Brigade and the Nigerian Army. The 52 promoted soldiers comprised six Master Warrant Officers, 10 Warrant Officers, 19 Staff Sergeants, five Sergeants, seven Corporals and five Lance Corporals. Highlights of the ceremony included words of advice from dignitaries and the Chief of Staff, Headquarters 4 Brigade, Colonel US Agbo, decoration of the beneficiaries with their new ranks and group photographs.
